review.note: Retracted in M40b: the war between the army and the Rapid Support Forces since April 2023. The atlas holds nothing in Sudan — not the Darfur war out of which the RSF came, not the revolution of 2019, not the secession of South Sudan — and there is no Portuguese link. It would need the Sudanese revolution, or Darfur, as a record before an honest edge could be written from either end.
